title: Needs better quality control.
text: One of the products (Lue hydrating serum) wasn't sealed and I won't be able to try it because it's empty. Even with that problem was the box worth $15 plus tax? I guess so, although it'd be nice to get a coupon code. I'll try it for the next few months.  I'll edit and let you know if this is a recurring problem.
label: neutral
